notes.title: Update 1.3.1.0 is available now. Performance, optimization, QoL, fixes!
notes.content:
Hey!

First, we'd like to thank you for supporting Gameboom VR! Our Cooking Simulator VR sells great, we've won the VR Game of the Year award on Steam, and now we can work on some new games for you. However, this does not mean that we are forgetting about our first game - Thief Simulator VR!

Thief Simulator VR receives another patch today, which introduces a number of improvements. The new version of the game is full of changes that improve both the performance of the game and its mechanics. Full changelog below:

Changes:
- The game is 1GB smaller
- Graphical optimization (materials, shaders, big textures)
- New functionality - you can use fast travel within one neighborhood, using the car
- It is easier to get in and start the car
- It is easier to hide in designated places (wardrobe, bed, dumpster)
- Limiting memory consumption for weaker RAM and VRAM (texture compression)
- Removal of information about too weak VRAM (textures compress automatically)
- NPC pathfinding calculations are lighter
- UI Change - Text display is less resource-intensive
- Better texture blending
- Additional info about remote grab in the tutorial
- Larger default remote grab distance
- In seated mode, the player's belt is higher
- More stable handling of quickslots on the belt
- By default, crouching is always lower than standing (seated mode)

Fixes:
- Some items were floating above the ground
- Duplicating items
- Some materials shined too much
- Removal of lag at the first breaking of the window
- Some objects were showing through the fog
- The mountains in the second neighborhood were disappearing
- The player's character does not jitter
- The tablet does not jitter while driving
- The paintings are not pixelated
- A typo in the Polish language version
- Some windows looked broken but were not
- Crowbar could not be raised
- 3 or 4 hands were rendered when the game couldn't determine if we were playing by Steam or Oculus

Join us on Discord! https://discord.gg/dERxD78

Thanks for constant support and sharing your valuable feedback!

Best,
Gameboom VR Team

notes.title: Performance+ patch available on beta branch
notes.content:
Hey!

We've been a little quiet lately. We owe you a few words of explanation about what is happening in GameBoom VR.

We are currently still working on the Performance+ update that we announced. Why does it take so much time? It's because we carefully check every element of the game.

TL;DR
Thief Simulator VR requires very thorough code analysis. If you want to help - we invite you to beta testing. Details of the beta at the end.

Performance+:

What are we doing at GameBoom VR to make Thief and future games run better?

- We transform the map so that there is no place where your frame rate will drop. This requires repeatedly analyzing the map and adjusting the game for performance degradation.
- In addition, developers are redesigning AI to make it behave more naturally and without problems for CPU.
- We also deal with how objects in the game are displayed. Our new system [Universal Render Pipeline] makes the game offer more frames per second.
- We also decided to switch to the latest version of the Unity engine
-The previous light and shadow system has been replaced by a completely new solution. It is "friendlier" for VR technology.
-That's not all - developers are also rewriting the game code. In this way, we can be sure that everything will run smoothly, without "tiring" the computer.
- We also deal with shaders. In short, it's about the way the texture displays on the object. For example: if our "sun" shines orange, then what should the object in the game look like - brighter, more orange? We check, improve and optimize.
- Sometimes a strange situation may cause a decrease in performance - we collect data from you and check such situations. For this we force the game to "difficult conditions" to check what the game code does not cope with.

Beta-:

Now you can download the current version of the update, which should improve the performance of the game on your computers. How to download "beta-" files you will learn from this thread.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1019550/discussions/0/1740010344366175625/

Remember to download “beta-”!!!

What information do we need from you?

The ideal feedback is:
-screenshot with FPS number
Frame times from SteamVR (Click three horizontal lines in the SteamVR window -> Developer -> Advanced Frame Timing
-Processor
-Graphics Card
-RAM
-VR headset

also the general impressions about the new patch - even without the all above - are very welcome!

And here is the thread where you can give us your feedback and share your impressions:

notes.title: New patch (v 1.1.1) is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello there,

with a little delay, but we are finally ready to push new patch to public.  In short: we fixed all urgent bugs, improved performance (~10% on GPU, on CPU - we removed big spikes during robbering and police chase) and made the game more forgiving in some aspects (it's easier to put smaller items in backpack and it's easier to carry the TV). Also we change quality settings, we admit that we overdid them - if you played above Very Low and want to keep the same quality - move one step higher e.g. if you played on Medium, set quality settings to High (more details in full change log).
As promised, we continue our work on improving game in all aspects according to your feedback (which is great and very helpful!). We are also moving to the new game engine which should be a big step in terms of performance!
Thanks for your great attitude and happy playing!

Here is the full change log:

Patch v1.1.1 (changes from v1.0.2):

Changes and new things:
- Better performance on GPU
- Quality Settings changed:
  Very low - the same
  Low - half texture size, the rest stays the same
  Medium - old Low
  High - old Medium
  Very High - Old High
- GPS map in a car
- People notice that you're using a flashlight on them
- You can open some stoves (but not all currently!)
- You can set fire on stoves (but not on all currently!)
- You can set fire on barbecues
- Interactable curtains (it's experimental, you can set it on in options)
- Grass performance (less grass diversity)
- Easier carrying old tv
- Finger on drill moves when you use it
- Tutorial: 'Hide your crowbar' changed to 'Put back your crowbar'
- Player is now teleported to the 'start' position after falling down through the map

Fixed:
- Walking and running is sometimes slower/faster
- Getting stuck near bath
- Items fall through backpack when trying to collect it
- A drill doesn't show up when disassembling the second car
- Gearbox and interceptor couldn't be taken off when disassembling a pickup
- Anti-burglar blinds for windows don't lock the window (only when they fall down because of the late hour)
- Cut window sets locked if the police were called when we grab the window
- Manget hand showing when the player keeps grabbing after the item was taken from his hand
- Fix NPC stacks (especially policeman)
- Cars have different wheels during disassembling (than on neighborhoods)
- Direction movement controller option, the controller that is responsible for walking now sets the direction of movement (previously controller responsible for rotation was doing this)
- Radio colliders in our house
- Gearstick moves too much
- Car box's text can be seen when you open inventory
- Windows at houses 113 and 108
- Disappearing candlestick in house 106
- Wrong scale of 'Jacket'
- Furniture colliders
- Doors' anchor points for lockpicks in houses 207 and 208

notes.title: Thief Simulator VR Release Date is here!
notes.content:
Hey, Thief Simulator VR community! 

We've got the information you're all waiting for! Your numerous messages show us that we are working on something special and we have great motivation to provide the best VR game possible.
 Thief Simulator VR has been created for almost the entire last year, and we put all our hearts into this project. We are looking forward to seeing our game in your hands. However, we all understand how business works - a wrong release date could cause other games to steal (pun intended) our visibility in digital stores. The current Steam Halloween Sale would take away our visibility, and we want our game to reach as many players as possible, which will convert into the resources needed for its further development (and Prison Simulator VR). For this reason, we decided with our publisher that Thief Simulator VR will appear on the market on November 12, 2019. 
Don't worry about changing the release date - our beta-testers can confirm that the title is ready for Early Access, can be completed and it's really fun. 
We will use the extra time to develop the game further. Mark the date on the calendar and add the game to your wishlist! IT’S HAPPENING! We would also like to take this opportunity to thank beta-testers. Your feedback was extremely needed. You made the game work really well! But! If you still want to test the game - you can keep doing it. We have recently released a new update, and there will be another one before the launch day! The latest update will add new languages to the game, so we will have fourteen language versions! Remember – your feedback is always welcome.

Thank you for your patience
GameBoom VR Team
